evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Contrasts owned vs. rented as distinct categories of value — a proportionality framing that positions intelligence as an asset whose mode of acquisition changes its worth.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Labels perspective as an 'asset' — market-pricing register that frames a relational stance (what you keep vs. what is commodity) in cost-benefit terms.
